sentence_stem: Although I sent the form last week,
correct_completion: I have not received a confirmation yet.
full_sentence: Although I sent the form last week, I have not received a confirmation yet.
acceptable_variants: I still have not heard back from the company.
I have still not received any reply.

options.text: so I did not need to send it again.
options.why_wrong: 'So' shows a result, not a contrast. 'Although' needs a clause that contrasts with the first part of the sentence.
'Because' gives a reason. 'Although' signals contrast, not cause.

options.text: I have not received a confirmation yet.
the weather was very nice that day.
options.why_wrong: This is a true detail but unrelated to the form, so it does not complete the contrast started by 'although'.

explanation: After 'although', we need a clause that shows contrast with the first part of the sentence. Cause clauses and unrelated details do not complete the contrast.
